triage.note: Pair A of two. Nine ways the S8 wire breaks by NAME or by DEFAULT, one failure each, at an EXACT count so that both a regressed miss (too few) and a regressed over-fire (too many) go red. The nine: (1) the checkbox ships `checked`; (2) the fixture mode hardcodes `exclude_boilerplate: true` instead of reading the checkbox; (3) excludeBp() ignores the checkbox and returns a constant, which is (2) relocated one level up and severs all three modes at once; (4) the extracted-item pane renders `it.text`, showing UN-stripped text under a header that says 'boilerplate hidden'; (5) the truncation notice counts the un-stripped string; (6) the url handler reads `excludeBoilerplate` while the UI sends `exclude_boilerplate`; (7) the upload handler compares `== "true"` while the JS appends `=1`; (8) `_run` forwards `not exclude_boilerplate`, which also covers the older `extract_items(path)` shape; (9) the pane header no longer says it is hiding anything — the inverse of shape 4 and the same lie, since a silent strip is that label's absence over stripped text. Every OTHER hop in the pair is correctly wired, so a check that blanket-failed would overshoot the count rather than reach it.
triage.history: Grew 3 -> 5 -> 9 shapes across two review rounds, which is itself the finding: each round the check asserted one level below where the property actually lived. Round 1 (R2) added the name-binding shapes. Round 2 (R5) added shapes 4 and 5 — the R1 repair had moved the rendered string from a pinned field (`text`) to an unpinned one (`display_text`) read only by an index.html expression nothing looked at, so deleting `it.display_text ?? ` left invariant 36/36 and fast 78/78 fully green. Round 2 (R6) added shape 3. Shape 9 came from this implementer attacking its own repair rather than from the review. Pair B (ui-boilerplate-wire-values) carries the shapes that break by VALUE while every name is right.
triage.count_history: 9 -> 10 in the PR #58 round-1 repair (R6): `WIRE_API` splits into two pinned expressions — the arming gate `armed = escalate and ESCALATION_ENABLED` and the `extract_items` call that carries the GATED flag plus the process-wide budget — because the escalate flag deliberately no longer reaches `extract_items` unmodified, and a single pin saying 'unmodified' would have been pinning a lie. This fixture's `_run` is the deliberately-broken half of the pair, so it now misses both.
